title: Regular holidays in the Philippines for 2026
content: Proclamation No. 1006 sets ten regular holidays for 2026. New Year's Day is 2026-01-01. Maundy Thursday is 2026-04-02. Good Friday is 2026-04-03. Araw ng Kagitingan is 2026-04-09. Labor Day is 2026-05-01. Independence Day is 2026-06-12. National Heroes Day is 2026-08-31. Bonifacio Day is 2026-11-30. Christmas Day is 2026-12-25. Rizal Day is 2026-12-30. Separate proclamations cover Eid'l Fitr and Eid'l Adha. Source: https://elibrary.judiciary.gov.ph/thebookshelf/showdocs/7/99678 (checked 2026-10-09).

title: Five special non-working days fall in November and December 2026
content: As of 2026-10-07, Proclamation No. 1006 lists five special non-working days from November to December 2026. All Saints' Day is 2026-11-01. All Souls' Day is 2026-11-02. The Feast of the Immaculate Conception of Mary is 2026-12-08. Christmas Eve is 2026-12-24. The Last Day of the Year is 2026-12-31. The same proclamation lists 2026-02-25, the EDSA People Power Revolution Anniversary, as a special working day. Source: https://pco.gov.ph/news_releases/pbbm-issues-proclamation-declaring-regular-holidays-special-non-working-days-for-2026/ (checked 2026-10-07).

title: Eid'l Fitr was a regular holiday on 2026-03-20
content: As of 2026-10-07, Proclamation No. 1189, series of 2026, declares Friday, 2026-03-20 a regular holiday for Eid'l Fitr. Eid'l Fitr marks the Feast of Ramadhan. The Presidential Communications Office released the proclamation on 2026-03-13. The date has passed. Source: https://pco.gov.ph/news_releases/proclamation-no-1189-s-2026-declaring-friday-20-march-2026-a-regular-holiday-throughout-the-country-in-observance-of-eidl-fitr-feast-of-ramadhan/ (checked 2026-10-07).

title: Eid'l Adha was a regular holiday on 2026-05-27
content: As of 2026-10-07, Proclamation No. 1264 declares 2026-05-27 a regular holiday for Eid'l Adha. The Commission on Muslim Filipinos recommended the date. Acting Executive Secretary Ralph Recto signed it by authority of the President on 2026-05-21. The Presidential Communications Office released the news on 2026-05-22. The date has passed. Source: https://pco.gov.ph/news_releases/palace-declares-may-27-as-a-regular-holiday-for-eidl-adha-observance/ (checked 2026-10-07).
